mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE user_name=#{username})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jiedan_customer_name_reservation(user_name) VALUES(#{username}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_name = user_name
INSERT INTO jiedan_customer_batch(creator_id, request_key, payload_hash) VALUES(#{creator},#{key},#{hash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE creator_id = creator_id
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash AS hash, CAST(result_json AS CHAR CHARACTER SET utf8mb4) AS result FROM jiedan_customer_batch WHERE creator_id=#{creator} AND request_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE jiedan_customer_batch SET result_json=#{result} WHERE creator_id=#{creator} AND request_key=#{key}
update jiedan_order set customer_account = '' where customer_account collate utf8mb4_general_ci = convert(#{account} using utf8mb4) collate utf8mb4_general_ci
